thread:
morgan: Quick heads-up — scheduling an immutable image layer rotation for runtime nodes this Wed 11:00 PT. Goals: remove old unneeded libs, rotate cosign signer, and ensure audit logs still map to image SHAs. Need RBAC & KMS checks.

anya: Sounds good. Are we doing a rolling canary or full pool cutover? My vote: rolling canary + staged attestation verification. :thumbsup:

devon: Rolling canary. We'll want to invalidate any prefix/KV cache that depends on image metadata. Canary plan: 5% of nodes, 30m observation, then 25%/30m, then ramp.

sam: RBAC note — the image-bake service role currently has kms:Decrypt but not kms:Sign. For cosign key rotation we need kms:Sign on the signer principal (project/runtime-image-signer). Also update the registry deploy role to `storage.objects.get` for the new signed SBOMs.

morgan: Good catch. @sam can you paste the minimal IAM diff you want? We'll feed it to infra for fast apply.

sam: Minimal diff (GCP style):
```
- roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner
```
And grant to `serviceAccount:project-runtime-image-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

security-bot: CI job `image-scan-master` reports an allowlist drift for package `libcurl` on the new base. See https://ci.internal.redwood/image-scan/17379 (warning, not blocking).

anya: We should triage that libcurl finding — looks like a minor patch-level diff from the new distro snapshot. If it’s only the version number and no CVE, ok to proceed after a quick vuln review. Devon, can you own the triage?

devon: On it. I'll check CVE DB and the SBOM diff. ETA 2 hours. Will post results here.

morgan: On the KMS side, confirm that key policy allows cross-project verification from our audit/attest service. We need attest verify (cosign verify) to succeed from the ops verifier principal.

sam: Policy snippet to allow verification (JSON):
```
{"bindings": [{"role": "roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer","members":["serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}]}
```
This exposes only the public key for signature verification.

oncall: Also add a quick rollback play: if canary failure >5% error rate or attestation mismatch, revert image tag pointer to previous SHA and mark as incident. Keep commands handy:
```
# revert registry tag to previous sha
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:previous-sha registry/current-tag
# reapply old runtime pool config
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:previous-sha -n runtime
```

morgan: Agree. We'll script that and keep it in the release folder. Also: update audit mapping so that image SHA -> SBOM and cosign signature are attached to the same audit record. Ops/telemetry needs to accept the new signed SBOM schema v2.

anya: Ops/telemetry pinged. They want the sample payload for the audit log change. Morgan, can you draft a 1-min example payload?

morgan: Example payload (small):
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:abcd1234...",
  "sbom_ref": "gs://sboms/sha256-abcd.json",
  "cosign_sig": "projects/.../locations/.../keys/.../signatures/1234",
  "deployed_by": "serviceAccount:deployer",
  "timestamp": "2025-04-02T18:11:00Z"
}
```

devon: Update: libcurl finding is a version bump (7.x -> 7.x+1) with no CVEs in NVD. Marking as non-blocker. Will attach SBOM diff in 25m.

morgan: Great. Action items: 1) @sam open IAM MR for kms:Sign + publicKeyViewer binding, 2) @devon attach SBOM diff + triage note, 3) @anya schedule canary cohorts in release calendar, 4) @oncall add rollback snippet to runbook. We'll target Wed 11:00 PT; canaries start at 11:00.

anya: I'll put a 45-min booking for the initial window and add owners.

sam: IAM MR created: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/merge-requests/5123 — includes terraform diff and testplans. Please review quickly.

security-bot: Reminder: add `auditlog:write` checks for the attestor so that attestations are tracked.

morgan: Noted. We'll add auditlog emit before promoting any tag.

oncall: I'll be on watch during the windows. If anything looks weird I'll escalate to incident channel + paging.

morgan: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll merge the MR after two approvals and proceed with Wed plan.

anya: No objections from me. :+1:

devon: All clear from vuln triage side.

sam: Approved.

morgan: Merging and tagging runbook now. Will post runbook link once live.
